# mtncloud_archive_bucket (Resource)

An archive (Tools > Archives in the console): a file store for your tenant whose files are kept in a MOS bucket. Destroy deletes the archive and every file in it, also from the MOS bucket; it refuses while the archive holds files unless `force_destroy` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_mos_bucket" "exports" {
  name = "acme-exports"
}

# An archive (Tools > Archives) that keeps its files in that bucket.
resource "mtncloud_archive_bucket" "exports" {
  name          = "acme-exports"
  description   = "Nightly exports"
  mos_bucket_id = mtncloud_mos_bucket.exports.id # or: mos_bucket = mtncloud_mos_bucket.exports.name

  # Optional: let anyone download the files without logging in. Off by default.
  public_url = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The archive's name. Names are unique across every tenant on MTN Cloud. Changing it renames the archive in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Destroy the archive even while it holds files. They are deleted with it, also from the MOS bucket.
- `mos_bucket` (String) The MOS bucket the files are kept in, by its name in MOS (`mtncloud_mos_bucket.x.name`). It must be registered in the console (Infrastructure > Storage > Buckets), as `mtncloud_mos_bucket` does. Set this or `mos_bucket_id`. Changing the bucket replaces the archive, and its files are lost.
- `mos_bucket_id` (String) The MOS bucket by its console record ID (`mtncloud_mos_bucket.x.id`). Set this or `mos_bucket`. Changing the bucket replaces the archive, and its files are lost.
- `public_url` (Boolean) Let anyone download the archive's files from their public URL, **without logging in**. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `file_count` (Number) How many files the archive holds.
- `id` (String) The archive's ID.
- `size_bytes` (Number) The total size of its files, in bytes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By the archive's ID
terraform import mtncloud_archive_bucket.exports 16
# or by its name
terraform import mtncloud_archive_bucket.exports acme-exports
```
